propositions: When identity.require_authenticated is ON, rebar verify-authorship must flag unsigned/unknown-author/bad-signature events and exit non-zero; when OFF it exits 0 (advisory).
Replay never rejects: events with bad author_sig or missing author_sig still fold into compiled state without raising or dropping.
The reducer records per-ticket authorship presence as counts (signed/unsigned) distinct from cryptographic verdict; show and fsck surface these counts.
Snapshots preserve authorship_ledger (event_uuid, author_id, author_sig, epoch tuples) so post-compaction verify-authorship can verify from the ledger when raw event files are gone.

Optional write-time signing in append_event: when identity resolves and signing_key is configured, sign the event's canonical bytes and store DSSE envelope as author_sig; signing failure logs but does not block the write.
Local write-gate in append_event fails fast with user guidance when identity.require_authenticated is ON and the write cannot be signed (no identity or no key); gate-exempt types are unaffected.
